item.title: SoCal weather: Heat and wind advisories issued as temperatures climb
item.description: Southern California is expected to see summerlike heat and lingering winds on Sunday, with temperatures reaching the upper 80s and 90s in some areas.

item.title: Street takeover leads to police chase that went from LA to Long Beach
item.description: A street takeover near Figueroa Street and 11th Street early Saturday morning led to a police chase that stretched from Los Angeles to Long Beach.

item.title: Oil and gas prices rapidly rise as Iran war shows no signs of letting up
item.description: The price of oil surged higher and showed no signs of halting its rapid climb a week after the U.S. and Israel launched major attacks on Iran that escalated into a war in the Middle East.

item.title: LA County investing $100 million for mental health services by leasing empty state facilities
item.description: Local leaders have broken ground on a project to turn vacant state buildings at the Metropolitan State Hospital in Norwalk into a new mental health facility for Los Angeles County.

item.title: IPIC Theaters files for bankruptcy for 2nd time in 7 years, closing Westwood and Pasadena locations
item.description: IPIC Theaters, the luxury dine-in movie chain, has filed for bankruptcy for the second time in seven years and plans to close its Westwood and Pasadena locations.

item.title: Giant inflatable colon display at UCLA highlights rising colorectal cancer risk in young adults
item.description: A walk-through, inflatable colon was put on display Friday, allowing visitors to see and learn about polyps, early-stage cancers and advanced disease.

item.title: Chevrolet introduces 'electrified hypercar' Corvette: the ZR1X with 1250 street-legal horsepower
item.description: Chevrolet says the ZR1X can leap from a standstill to 60 miles per hour in just two seconds.

item.title: Gas prices jump across SoCal as one LA station hits $8 a gallon
item.description: The statewide average climbed above $5 per gallon and some drivers encountered prices more than $8 at the pump.

item.title: Timothée Chalamet faces backlash over comments about opera and ballet in recent interview
item.description: Actor and Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet is facing criticism from members of the opera and ballet communities after comments he made during a recent interview.

item.title: Suspects accused of stealing debit card, draining account in alleged distraction theft scheme
item.description: The Los Angeles Police Department is asking for the public's help identifying two men accused of stealing from seniors in what was described as a "distraction ID theft scheme."
